ModMetaData.name: Ancient & Medieval Japan - Grains（中世日本 - 穀類）
ModMetaData.author: sucRo0629
ModMetaData.description:
Development build of Ancient & Medieval Japan - Grains.
Adds dry-field grains, harvesting and processing, flour milling, and basic grain foods inspired by pre-Edo Japan. When used with Medieval Overhaul, AMJG's owned crop and processing settings take precedence, while shared MO wheat, flour, milling, and straw assets are reused where appropriate.
The production dependency declaration still requires Medieval Overhaul; removing this hard dependency is gated separately on release and existing-save verification. Crop Cold Tolerance Overhaul is optional. New Village is owned by the separate AMJ Scenarios mod (only a legacy compatibility copy remains when Scenarios is absent).
Save compatibility: Safe addition/removal and migration of older Core saves remain unverified. The current build is not certified for public release.
